description: Tables still free at a venue on a date, from the live floor plan minus tables already requested or confirmed. Filter by party size, zone or maximum minimum-spend. Each table carries its zone, seats and minimum spend in AED.

max_min_spend.description: Only tables with a minimum spend at or under this, AED.

party.description: Number of guests; returns tables seating party..party+4.

venue.description: Venue id or name (billionaire, gigi, bagatelle, lepiaf, verde, raspoutine, coucou) — or an event name like "The List".

zone.description: Restrict to one zone, e.g. Stage, Terrace, Veranda.
